Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang's link to a suspected Chinese spy.

• Nvidia's board says it is starting an independent investigation into its CEO.
• A memo seen by US officials claims a tech executive was recruited by China's spy agency to spy on him.
• Huang told staff he had an affair with that executive and apologised to the company.

items.text:
Apple's boss wants Siri to become a powerful AI agent, Bloomberg reports.

• Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says Apple's CEO is pushing to speed up the Siri roadmap.
• Siri is expected to edit photos and organise Safari tabs with iOS 27.3.
• Ordering on Grubhub or booking on OpenTable could come in the Spring.

Our read: Siri could soon carry out ongoing tasks in your apps, not just one-offs.

items.text:
Google Health lets you switch off its AI Coach and keep Premium.

• The AI Coach comes only with Google Health Premium, not the free tier.
• Tap your profile photo, then Your data, then Feature privacy controls.
• Your past data stays, and you can turn the Coach back on any time.

Do this: Save this for the day the Coach's constant advice gets too much.
